_schema: Run 29 session 2 - independent MAIN-AGENT crosscheck (R7) of Phase-4 verifier verdicts. The main agent re-searched every candidate the verifiers labeled OPEN, applying the STRICT gate: GAP_OPEN = no prior application AT ALL; any real adjacency (incl. the same technique-family on a sibling/industrial domain, or the application served by a different method) => GAP_NARROW (capability-gap).
headline: All 5 verifier-OPEN labels OVERTURNED to NARROW on independent crosscheck. Every candidate has documented prior adjacency. Final: 0 GAP_OPEN, 11 GAP_NARROW (capability-gap), 1 NARROW-near-CLOSED.

PINN-based virtual thermal sensor with real-time millisecond field/heat-flux estimation from sparse sensors

overturns.exact_unused_slice: SGNO-style STABLE LONG-HORIZON autoregressive rollout for real-time CORE-temperature forecasting to time an INTERRUPTED (mar-)quench on an IRREGULAR hand-forged artisan part. Neural quench-field surrogates exist; the interrupted-quench-timing + irregular-artisan-geometry + long-horizon-rollout combination is unmade.
overturns.why_not_open: Neural-network surrogates for quench temperature fields (incl. real-time virtual thermal sensors) already exist; this is capability-gap, not virgin ground.
